services.name: SEO & Google Search Ranking
services.short: On-page, technical and local SEO so customers can find your business on Google.
services.title: SEO Services in Lahore: On-Page & Local SEO | DEVSOLE Soft
services.description: SEO services from DEVSOLE Soft, Lahore: technical fixes, on-page optimization, page speed, Google Search Console and Google Business Profile setup for local search.
services.h1: SEO Services in Lahore for Google Search & Maps
intro: DEVSOLE Soft helps businesses in Lahore and across Pakistan become easier to find on Google. Because we are developers, we fix SEO problems in the website code itself: speed, structure, page titles and structured data.
SEO takes time and no one can honestly guarantee a specific position. What we do is remove the technical barriers, target the right search terms and set up the tools so you can measure progress.

sections.heading: What is included
bullets: Technical SEO audit: crawling, indexing, canonical tags, sitemap and robots.txt
Keyword research for your services and city
On-page optimization of titles, descriptions, headings and internal links
Page speed and Core Web Vitals improvements
Schema markup for your business, services and articles
Google Search Console setup and sitemap submission
Google Business Profile setup for Google Maps and local search

sections.heading: Who it is for
paragraphs: Local businesses that want to appear when nearby customers search for their service, and companies whose existing website looks fine but gets little traffic from search.

sections.heading: How we measure results
paragraphs: We track clicks, impressions and search terms in Google Search Console, and calls and direction requests in Google Business Profile. You see the same reports we do.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes can be picked up within weeks, but ranking for competitive search terms usually takes several months of consistent work.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee the first position on Google?
faqs.a: No, and no honest provider can. Rankings depend on competition and on Google. We commit to the work, the reporting and steady improvement.

faqs.q: Do you do SEO for websites you did not build?
faqs.a: Yes. We audit the existing site first and tell you what can be fixed in place and what would need rebuilding.

paragraphs: Businesses whose website no longer reflects the quality of their work, looks broken on mobile, or was built on a template that has become slow and hard to update.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: We design directly in code using Tailwind CSS, so what you approve in the preview link is exactly what goes live. You own the finished design and all source files.

faqs.a: It should not if it is done carefully. We keep URLs and content where we can and set up redirects for anything that moves.
